verses.original: שִׁ֥יר מִזְמ֗וֹר לִבְנֵ֫י קֹ֥רַח לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ עַל־ מָחֲלַ֣ת לְעַנּ֑וֹת מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל לְהֵימָ֥ן הָאֶזְרָחִֽי׃ יְ֭הוָה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יְשׁוּעָתִ֑י יוֹם־ צָעַ֖קְתִּי בַלַּ֣יְלָה נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šîr miz·mō·wr liḇ·nê qō·raḥ lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘al- mā·ḥă·laṯ lə·‘an·nō·wṯ maś·kîl lə·hê·mān hā·’ez·rā·ḥî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yə·šū·‘ā·ṯî yō·wm- ṣā·‘aq·tî ḇal·lay·lāh neḡ·de·ḵā
verses.literal: A song A Psalm of the sons of Korah For the choirmaster According to Mahalath Leannoth A Maskil of Heman the Ezrahite O LORD the God of my salvation day and night I cry out before You
verses.literalPt: Ó Jeová, Deus da minha salvação, dia e noite clamei diante de ti.

verses.original: תָּב֣וֹא לְ֭פָנֶיךָ תְּפִלָּתִ֑י הַטֵּֽה־ אָ֝זְנְךָ֗ לְרִנָּתִֽי׃
verses.literal: May my prayer come before You incline Your ear to my cry
verses.literalPt: Chegue à tua presença a minha oração inclina os teus ouvidos ao meu clamor.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ שָֽׂבְעָ֣ה בְרָע֣וֹת נַפְשִׁ֑י וְחַיַּ֗י לִשְׁא֥וֹל הִגִּֽיעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- śā·ḇə·‘āh ḇə·rā·‘ō·wṯ nap̄·šî wə·ḥay·yay liš·’ō·wl hig·gî·‘ū
verses.literal: For my soul is full of troubles and my life draws near to Sheol
verses.literalPt: Pois a minha alma está cheia de sofrimentos, e a minha vida se aproxima do Sheol.

verses.original: נֶ֭חְשַׁבְתִּי עִם־ י֣וֹרְדֵי ב֑וֹר הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כְּגֶ֣בֶר אֵֽין־ אֱיָֽל׃
verses.literal: I am counted among those descending to the Pit I am like a man without strength
verses.literalPt: Sou contado com os que baixam à cova, sou como homem sem socorro,

verses.original: בַּמֵּתִ֗ים חָ֫פְשִׁ֥י כְּמ֤וֹ חֲלָלִ֨ים׀ שֹׁ֥כְבֵי קֶ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹ֣א זְכַרְתָּ֣ם ע֑וֹד וְ֝הֵ֗מָּה מִיָּדְךָ֥ נִגְזָֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bam·mê·ṯîm ḥā·p̄ə·šî kə·mōw ḥă·lā·lîm šō·ḵə·ḇê qe·ḇer ’ă·šer lō zə·ḵar·tām ‘ō·wḏ wə·hêm·māh mî·yā·ḏə·ḵā niḡ·zā·rū
verses.literal: I am forsaken among the dead like the slain who lie in the grave whom You remember no more who are cut off from Your care
verses.literalPt: atirado entre os mortos; como os que, feridos de morte, jazem na sepultura, dos quais não te lembras mais, e que são desamparados das tuas mãos.

verses.literal: You have laid me in the lowest Pit in the darkest of the depths
verses.literalPt: Puseste-me na cova mais profunda, em lugares escuros, em densas trevas.

verses.original: עָ֭לַי סָמְכָ֣ה חֲמָתֶ֑ךָ וְכָל־ מִ֝שְׁבָּרֶ֗יךָ עִנִּ֥יתָ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.literal: Your wrath weighs heavily upon me all Your waves have submerged me Selah
verses.literalPt: Sobre mim pesa o teu furor, e me afliges com todas as tuas ondas. (Selá)

verses.original: הִרְחַ֥קְתָּ מְיֻדָּעַ֗י מִ֫מֶּ֥נִּי שַׁתַּ֣נִי תוֹעֵב֣וֹת לָ֑מוֹ כָּ֝לֻ֗א וְלֹ֣א אֵצֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: hir·ḥaq·tā mə·yud·dā·‘ay mim·men·nî šat·ta·nî ṯō·w·‘ê·ḇō·wṯ lā·mōw kā·lu wə·lō ’ê·ṣê
verses.literal: You have removed my friends from me You have made me repulsive to them I am confined and cannot escape
verses.literalPt: Apartaste de mim os meus conhecidos, fizeste-me objeto de abominação para com eles; estou encerrado e não posso sair.

verses.original: עֵינִ֥י דָאֲבָ֗ה מִנִּ֫י עֹ֥נִי קְרָאתִ֣יךָ יְהוָ֣ה בְּכָל־ י֑וֹם שִׁטַּ֖חְתִּי אֵלֶ֣יךָ כַפָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·nî ḏā·’ă·ḇāh min·nî ‘ō·nî qə·rā·ṯî·ḵā Yah·weh bə·ḵāl yō·wm šiṭ·ṭaḥ·tî ’ê·le·ḵā ḵap·pāy
verses.literal: My eyes grow dim with grief I call to You daily . . . O LORD I spread out my hands to You
verses.literalPt: Os meus olhos desfalecem de aflição; dia após dia, tenho clamado a ti, Jeová, estendendo-te as minhas mãos.

verses.original: הֲלַמֵּתִ֥ים תַּעֲשֶׂה־ פֶּ֑לֶא אִם־ רְ֝פָאִ֗ים יָק֤וּמוּ׀ יוֹד֬וּךָ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lam·mê·ṯîm ta·‘ă·śeh- pe·le ’im- rə·p̄ā·’îm yā·qū·mū yō·w·ḏū·ḵā se·lāh
verses.literal: Do You work wonders . . . for the dead Do departed spirits rise up to praise You Selah
verses.literalPt: Acaso, mostrarás maravilhas aos mortos? Porventura, levantar-se-ão as sombras dos mortos e te louvarão?

verses.literal: Can Your loving devotion be proclaimed in the grave Your faithfulness in Abaddon
verses.literalPt: Será referida a tua benignidade na sepultura? Ou a tua fidelidade, em Abadom?

verses.original: הֲיִוָּדַ֣ע בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ פִּלְאֶ֑ךָ וְ֝צִדְקָתְךָ֗ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ נְשִׁיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yiw·wā·ḏa‘ ba·ḥō·šeḵ pil·’e·ḵā wə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā bə·’e·reṣ nə·šî·yāh
verses.literal: Will Your wonders be known in the darkness or Your righteousness in the land of oblivion
verses.literalPt: Acaso, serão conhecidas nas trevas as tuas maravilhas? E a tua justiça, na terra do esquecimento?

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְהוָ֣ה שִׁוַּ֑עְתִּי וּ֝בַבֹּ֗קֶר תְּֽפִלָּתִ֥י תְקַדְּמֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ’ê·le·ḵā Yah·weh šiw·wa‘·tî ū·ḇab·bō·qer tə·p̄il·lā·ṯî ṯə·qad·də·me·kā
verses.literal: But to You O LORD I cry for help in the morning my prayer comes before You
verses.literalPt: Mas eu, a ti, Jeová, clamo por socorro, e, pela manhã, virá diante de ti a minha oração.

verses.original: לָמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תִּזְנַ֣ח נַפְשִׁ֑י תַּסְתִּ֖יר פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: lā·māh Yah·weh tiz·naḥ nap̄·šî tas·tîr pā·ne·ḵā mim·men·nî
verses.literal: Why O LORD do You reject me Why do You hide Your face from me
verses.literalPt: Por que, Jeová, rejeitas a minha alma? Por que escondes de mim o teu rosto?

verses.original: עָ֘נִ֤י אֲנִ֣י וְגֹוֵ֣עַ מִנֹּ֑עַר נָשָׂ֖אתִי אֵמֶ֣יךָ אָפֽוּנָה׃
verses.literal: From my youth I was afflicted and near death I have borne Your terrors I am in despair
verses.literalPt: Tenho estado aflito, a ponto de morrer desde a minha mocidade; sob o peso dos teus terrores, estou desorientado.

verses.literal: Your wrath has swept over me Your terrors have destroyed me
verses.literalPt: Por cima de mim, passaram as tuas iras, os teus terrores deram cabo de mim.

verses.original: סַבּ֣וּנִי כַ֭מַּיִם כָּל־ הַיּ֑וֹם הִקִּ֖יפוּ עָלַ֣י יָֽחַד׃
verses.transliteration: sab·bū·nî ḵam·ma·yim kāl- hay·yō·wm hiq·qî·p̄ū ‘ā·lay yā·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: All day long they engulf me like water they enclose me on every side
verses.literalPt: Cercaram-me eles, como água, de contínuo; à uma, me circundaram.

verses.original: הִרְחַ֣קְתָּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי אֹהֵ֣ב וָרֵ֑עַ מְֽיֻדָּעַ֥י מַחְשָֽׁךְ׃
verses.literal: You have removed my beloved and my friend darkness is my closest companion
verses.literalPt: Apartaste de mim amigo e companheiro; os meus íntimos amigos são trevas.
